name: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc.
summary: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for Rhinebeck Bank that provides banking and financial products and services to consumer and commercial customers in the Hudson Valley region of New York, the United States. The company offers deposits, including non-interest-bearing demand, interest-bearing demand, money market, commercial and personal checking, individual retirement, and savings accounts, as well as certificates of deposit.
